"Hang-chau-fu with the Lake, Compiled from Various Chinese Sources", a map of late Qing-dynasty Hangzhou and West Lake with irregular 19th-century romanizations of most Chinese place names.


The inset map "Plan of the City of Si-ngan-fu, Reduced from One Published under the Mongol Dynasty" is a map of Yuan-dynasty Xi'an, again with irregular 19th-century romanizations of some place names. Others are numbered 1–29 without a visible guide to the numbers' meaning.
